findings.title: A configuration job cancelled while queued still calls the native adapter; cancellation is not checked before CLI start
Batch trash proceeds if an external native writer becomes active after membership scan and before the HOME lease
Failed configuration calls revoke the captured admission certificate with record CAS
Credential or dependency rotation during failure cannot redirect revocation from the captured scope
Preflight rejection without a captured verification reference preserves a newer certificate
Concurrent proposal completion returns a coherent state and payload snapshot
A native transcript change before the batch lease is detected and aborts all cleanup side effects

limitations: The prior supervised CLI attempt timed out at 1800 seconds without producing a verdict; that raw attempt remains unaltered and is not an approval. This continuation completed bounded focused checks only.

The preserved focused counterexample run reproduces two open defects: queued cancellation still reaches CLI.start, and batch cleanup proceeds when external occupancy begins after the lease is taken. The companion test confirming membership/history changes before lease are rejected passes. No model call was made by this review.

The configuration proposal plan schema admits mode=Agent, which maps to a visibly disclosed workspace-write proposal in the draft. Applying remains draft-only; execution still requires the separate run authorization and admission gates. This is not treated as an execution-permission grant, but reviewers should not interpret permissions_granted=false as meaning the resulting graph cannot contain a proposed write-mode node.

Source identity and the sealed evidence manifest were previously verified in this same review context: 203 source files, 97 evidence entries, reconstructed Git tree fba14fd997a73fab707dd6d6a8327e4f90081a1e. Regression, syntax, rebuild, Chromium, native, catalog, AI-journey, and privacy records are manifest-bound; most were inspected rather than rerun. The recorded 711-test Python suite and 82-case workbench browser suite are supplied results, not a claim that this continuation reran them.

The candidate’s local nested user-namespace restriction prevents independent execution of host bubblewrap assertions here: the local host-isolation suite and one native-terminal wrapper test fail before their isolation assertions because unprivileged namespace creation is denied. The sealed normal-host regression log reports six passed host tests; it is distinguished from this reviewer’s local execution, not silently substituted for it.

Real evidence records the configuration proposal being generated, applied, and its workflow run, and same-UUID Codex/Claude questions with visible answers. Requested/reported model identities are present where recorded; physical backend, effective effort, and verified billing remain unknown.

A directory-model UI registration is supported by the recorded current-candidate catalog proof and separate synthetic UI regression; registration remains distinct from execution admission. User personal UX acceptance remains pending. The old Task03 limited accepts and Gate BLOCKED records are historical only; no current fixed Gate was invoked, and this report does not claim formal technical acceptance, Stable approval, merge, or promotion.

No source, authority, credential, native transcript, commit, push, merge, or Stable-promotion writes were made. The frozen source remains read-only; reviewer-created artifacts are confined to the new recovery scratch directory.
